name: UploadServiceNowAttachment
label: Upload ServiceNow Attachment
description: Uploads a file as an attachment to a record in ServiceNow using a Bearer token.

fields.name: CredentialId
fields.label: Credential (Bearer Token)
fields.description: The ServiceNow access token (OAuth2 Bearer token).

fields.name: TableName
fields.label: Table Name
fields.description: Name of the table (e.g., incident, change_request)

fields.name: RecordSysId
fields.label: Record Sys ID
fields.description: The sys_id of the record to attach the file to

fields.name: FileContent
fields.label: File Content (Byte Array)
fields.description: The file content as byte array

fields.name: FileName
fields.label: File Name
fields.description: Name of the file including extension (e.g., screenshot.png)

fields.name: ContentType
fields.label: Content Type
fields.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., image/png, application/pdf). Default: application/octet-stream

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from ServiceNow API

fields.name: AttachmentSysId
fields.label: Attachment Sys ID
fields.description: The sys_id of the created attachment (if successful)
